topic: Geometric Interpretation of Non-Square Matrices as Dimensional Transformations

sections.title: Prerequisite Refresher: The Mapping Perspective
lecture_lines: Matrices are functions transforming inputs into outputs.
A 2D vector gets mapped by a 2x2 matrix.
Transformation means rotation, scaling, or shearing.
animations: Show a vector space R^n with a grid and transformation T. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Represent the mapping as an arrow from R^n to R^m. (Color: #FF8080)
Visualize the domain R^n and codomain R^m as separated coordinate planes. (Color: #80FF80)

sections.title: Expanding Dimensions (m > n)
lecture_lines: Embedding maps low to high dimensions.
Think of a 2D plane in 3D space.
animations: Display a transformation from lower to higher dimensions using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg]. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Show the matrix A stretching vectors into R^m with grid expansion. (Color: #FF8080)
Visualize the span as a subspace in R^m using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg]. (Color: #80FF80)

sections.title: Compressing Dimensions (m < n)
lecture_lines: Projection collapses high to low dimensions.
Information is lost during this compression.
animations: Display a transformation from higher to lower dimensions using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/screen.svg] to represent the projection plane. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Show the matrix A squashing vectors into R^m on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/screen.svg]. (Color: #FF8080)
Highlight the information loss during projection as vectors map onto the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/screen.svg]. (Color: #80FF80)

sections.title: Visualizing the 'Null Space' Loss
lecture_lines: Null space represents information lost in projection.
Some inputs map directly to zero.
This is the cost of dimensionality reduction.
animations: Display the null space as a highlighted rectangular sub-region in R^n. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Animate vectors inside the null space rectangle shrinking to the origin. (Color: #FF8080)
Visualize the 'collapse' of the R^n volume into a lower-dimensional R^m subspace. (Color: #80FF80)

sections.title: Summary & Synthesis
lecture_lines: They act as either embeddings or projections.
These tools are vital for data science.

Flash key labels 'Expansion' and 'Compression' as the transformation matrix changes. (Color: #FF8080)
